summary: v0.7.0 connects Artist Mix and Prompt Builder, makes saved work easier to reuse, and brings clearer controls, previews, and card management across the studio.

whatsNew.title: Use Artist Mix in Prompt Builder
whatsNew.copy: Enable Use Artist Mix to include the same mix in your prompt, keep up to 12 artists with multiple anchors, set a range, clear quickly, and tune weights with readable controls and mouse-wheel support.

whatsNew.title: Save and reuse complete work
whatsNew.copy: Use the universal New tile to save prompts, Artist Mixes, and characters, then Use in Builder replaces the current Base Prompt, Undesired content, and Characters with editable saved content while Frame, Scene, Render, Artist Mix, and random range remain unchanged.

whatsNew.title: Manage several Custom Tags at once
whatsNew.copy: Use Custom Tags Select Mode to select multiple cards, move them to another folder, or delete them together.

whatsNew.title: Previews stay ready while browsing
whatsNew.copy: Image-only hover previews adapt to each card and grid previews stay ready while you browse, filter, or change folders. Original files stay unchanged.

whatsNew.title: Set a comfortable interface scale
whatsNew.copy: Choose 100%, 110%, or 125% and keep the setting between sessions for clearer controls, focus states, and readable text.

whatsNew.title: A calmer studio to work in
whatsNew.copy: Use the glass header and dedicated Base Prompt with quick clear, keep hover focus stable, and get quiet success updates while warnings stay visible when attention is needed.

cleanupNotice.title: A note about older system temporary files
cleanupNotice.copy: We're sorry. v0.7.0 keeps installed runtime temporary files in the installed app's own profile directory at data/temp instead of the Windows system %TEMP%. Cache files stay in data/cache. Earlier builds could duplicate preview, cache, and temporary files in the system location and consume substantial system-drive space. Historical leftovers are not removed automatically.
steps: Close NAI Prompt Studio and its installer.
First, use Windows Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files and review and remove temporary files.
For targeted cleanup, press Win+R, enter %TEMP%, and remove only clearly identifiable old NAI Prompt Studio, Electron, or ASAR-related leftovers. Skip anything in use or uncertain.
